title: Choose Which Types of Sub & Sub-Sub Categories Display on Member Profiles
text:
## Choose Which Types of Sub & Sub-Sub Categories Display on Member Profiles
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000074407
By default sub and sub-sub categories will display on member's profiles, once these have been selected by the member in the Additional Details form:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105280618/original/lZEVhhuDmQWGvKXennXVXNAGlNGf8-o9-w.png?1645318575 | alt: ]

## Select Sub & Sub-sub Category Displa y
In order to display only the sub-sub categories navigate to Settings >> Advanced Settings:
Show Only Sub-Sub Categories On Member Profiles System Variable: show_subs_member_profile
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647394/original/mrZsclyOLPVOrzK9V199-bxBjm4ax4tc9Q.png?1753161214 | alt: ]
The available options are Subs only , Sub and sub-subs and sub-sub only :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647397/original/z5-gDdNpn2k12n9OulAByEHGGW-cvVmehg.png?1753161232 | alt: ]

## Sub-subs Only
If the Sub-subs only option has been selected, only Sub-Sub categories will show up in the Specialties tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105280634/original/7xvHaXC0qb0JAKHQ0ESosvmlVxF0qBBw8g.png?1645318716 | alt: ]

## Subs Only
If the Subs only option has been selected, only Sub categories will show up in the Specialties tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112329527/original/HTEozPfPjukFnxsiKwexgNyiAxpCamK28Q.png?1659023296 | alt: ]

## Sub and Sub-subs
If the Sub and sub-subs option have been selected, both Sub Categories and Sub-Sub Categories will show up in the Specialties tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12112329579/original/2L4WvxOwjBgzqWqdWBZklZKGcnpvo8pvAA.png?1659023361 | alt: ]
